blind.description: A stylized low-to-medium-poly birch tree. It features a slender white trunk with distinctive horizontal black markings and dark knots, flaring out into small roots at the base. The foliage consists of several rounded, scalloped clumps of bright lime-green leaves arranged along branches and at the crown. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and fully connected without holes, floating elements, or broken geometry.
blind.from_above: An extreme close-up filling the entire frame with smooth, lime-green faceted surfaces of the tree's uppermost foliage canopy.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 times as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (approx. 14 to 15 ft tall), with a canopy width of about 4 to 5 ft.
